construction_markdown:
No new code is claimed. This report audits attempts to raise the explicit RS–affine construction from dimension 1040 to 1041 through the upstream mixed-parity XOR gateway. Let `G=F_2^1039`, and let `q_0,q_1:G→Z_{≥0}` be the quotient-label multiplicities of the even and odd path classes. The exact gateway requires `|M_0-M_1|≤2^21` and `|q̂_0(ψ)|+|q̂_1(ψ)|≤2^21` for every nonzero character `ψ`.

The new work derives spectral support, divisibility, affine-branch, and algebraic-degree restrictions on every such pair. It also gives deterministic counter-witnesses against affine half-splits of the explicit RS–affine cloud, two natural half-length RS implementations, and all-one-containing exceptional-line cores. None of the surviving irregular cases is instantiated.

discussion_posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: combinatorial-r002-09 and the team integrator. For every mixed-parity gateway pair on `F_2^1039`, the combined distribution has at least `262145` distinct labels and the gcd of its positive multiplicities is at most `64`. More generally, the 88th-moment lemma says that an `m`-term multiset with normalized bias `2^{-a}` and `m≤2^{2a+5}` can span dimension at most `88a+43`. Hence any free label-preserving symmetry group has order at most 64, and any coset-invariant combined distribution has invariance dimension at most 6.
discussion_posts.subject: 88th-moment divisibility gate for mixed-parity lifts

discussion_posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: combinatorial-r002-09 and combinatorial-r002-10. Three natural k=1041 repairs are closed: every nonconstant affine half-split of the explicit RS–affine cloud has a character with parity `l1` correlation at least `2^22`; every shared degree-64 `F_{2^16}` two-half cloud has a scalar-pencil witness with two correlations equal to `2^21`; and every two-half `F_{2^15}` affine-RS scheme proved by a separate degree-sum root ledger has shared message dimension at most 974. A surviving construction must use index-dependent shifts, genuinely different inner linear parts, or a joint signed-fiber estimate outside these ledgers.
discussion_posts.subject: Affine splitting and both natural half-RS routes fail

discussion_posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: composition team integrator. The conditional `[8192,16,4092]_2` exceptional-line core cannot contain all-one. If it did, the `2^15` quotient cosets would give 32768 sign vectors in `R^8192` with pairwise inner products at most 8, whereas the trace-rank inequality permits fewer than 8257. Continue the core search only among aperiodic, non-antipodal multisets; can a symbolic construction with at least three Fourier values achieve the one-sided bound `S(a)≤8`?

generator_matrix.algorithm: Conditional audit emitter only. Index the explicit RS–affine base rows by `(i,j)∈{0,…,15}×{0,…,64}`. Given a deterministic path indexer `Path:{0,1}^30→` finite lists of base coordinates `(a,y)`, emit `G[(i,j),q]=XOR_{(a,y) in Path(q)} H(α^i a^j)_y` for all 1040 rows and all `q`, followed by one all-one row. This outputs every entry for any supplied indexer, but no qualifying indexer is claimed here.
generator_matrix.runtime_bound: If `Path(q)` has at most `n^c` entries and is computed in at most `n^c` bit operations for one fixed integer `c`, the complete conditional matrix is emitted in at most `1042·n^(c+1)+1041n` bit operations.
generator_matrix.runtime_proof: There are exactly `1040n` core entries and `n` final constant-row entries. Precomputing or directly evaluating the fixed degree-16 field expressions costs at most `1040n` fixed-width operations. Each core entry XORs at most `n^c` bits, and all path descriptions cost at most `n^(c+1)`. Thus the complete output is produced in `n^{O(1)}` time whenever the missing path indexer has the stated bounds.

obstructions: No pair of parity distributions satisfying the exact k=1041 gateway was constructed.
Regularity is severely limited: the combined multiplicity gcd is at most 64, coset-invariance dimension is at most 6, and support-only parallel cosets have direction dimension at most 11.
A parity-class indexer supported on at most 35 affine images of dimension at most 29 is impossible; 36–63 images must have direction-sum dimension at least 1034.

The results are scoped obstructions, not a universal nonexistence theorem: highly irregular, non-affine distributions with joint signed cancellation remain open.

proof_markdown:
## Spectral-amplification obstruction note

### 1. Exact gateway

Put `n=2^30`, `T=2^21`, and `G=F_2^1039`. Let `q_i(x)` count quotient label `x` in parity class `i`, and put `M_i=Σ_x q_i(x)`. The upstream parity theorem gives the necessary and sufficient inequalities

`|M_0-M_1|≤T`,

`|q̂_0(ψ)|+|q̂_1(ψ)|≤T` for every `0≠ψ∈G*`.

Indeed, the two extensions of `ψ` to the 1040-dimensional base have signed sums `E_ψ+O_ψ` and `E_ψ-O_ψ`, and `max(|E+O|,|E-O|)=|E|+|O|`.

### 2. Paired Parseval bound

Let `f=q_0+q_1` and `g=q_0-q_1`. For every nonprincipal character, both Fourier coefficients have magnitude at most `T`. Moreover `f̂(0)=n` and `|ĝ(0)|=|M_0-M_1|≤T`. Unnormalized Parseval gives

`||f||_2^2 ≤ T^2+(n^2-T^2)/2^1039 < T^2+1`.

The energy is integral, so `||f||_2^2≤T^2`. Directly, `||g||_2^2≤T^2`. Since

`2(Σq_0(x)^2+Σq_1(x)^2)=||f||_2^2+||g||_2^2`,

we obtain `Σq_0^2+Σq_1^2≤T^2`. Cauchy gives combined support at least `(n/T)^2=2^18`, and each parity support at least

`ceil(M_i^2/T^2)≥ceil((511/2)^2)=65281`.

### 3. Finite 88th-moment lemma

Let `d_1,…,d_m` be an ordered multiset in `F_2^h` satisfying

`|Σ_j (-1)^{ψ(d_j)}|≤m/2^a`

for every nonzero `ψ`, where `a≥7`. If `m≤2^(2a+5)`, then `h≤88a+43`.

For `m≤86`, the Fourier condition forces the labels to affinely span `F_2^h`, so `h≤m-1`. Assume `m>86`. Let `Z` count zero-XOR ordered 88-tuples of occurrence indices. Orthogonality gives

`2^h Z≤m^88+(2^h-1)A`, where `A=(m/2^a)^88`.

Tuples using 44 distinct occurrence indices exactly twice give

`Z≥L=(m)_44·87!!`.

For `R(m)=L/A`, differentiation yields

`d(log R)/dm≤44/(m-43)-88/m<0`.

At `M=2^(2a+5)`,

`R(M)=2^-220·87!!·Π_{i=0}^{43}(1-i/M)`.

Here `Σ_{i=0}^{43}i=946`, so the product is greater than `511/512`. The exact integer certificate

`87!!-9·2^218=175044325267227424617219137773346514042305501996957786457939574329>0`

implies `R(M)>(9/4)(511/512)>2`. Thus `L>2A`. Rearranging the moment inequality gives `2^h(L-A)≤m^88-A`. Also `(m)_44>(m/2)^44` and `87!!>2^221`, whence `L>m^44·2^177`. Therefore

`2^h<2m^88/L<2^-176m^44≤2^(88a+44)`,

and hence `h≤88a+43`.

### 4. Regularity consequences

If every positive value of `f=q_0+q_1` is divisible by `ρ`, then `f/ρ` is a multiset of length `m=n/ρ` with normalized bias at most `1/512`. Since `ρ` divides `2^30`, it is a power of two. If `ρ≥128`, then `m≤2^23`; the moment lemma with `a=9` gives `1039≤835`, a contradiction. Hence `ρ≤64`.

Equality in the earlier combined-support bound would force `f=4096·1_S` on a set of size `2^18`, contradicting the same divisibility result. Thus `|supp f|≥262145`. A free label-preserving group action has orbit size dividing every fiber, hence order at most 64.

If `f` is invariant on cosets of an `s`-dimensional subspace, project to the quotient. Every projected multiplicity is divisible by `2^s`. Mass first gives `s≤30`, so the quotient dimension is at least 1009. The moment lemma rules out `s≥7`; therefore `s≤6`. If only the support is a union of complete cosets, quotient uncertainty gives at least `2^18+1` occupied cosets, and `(2^18+1)2^s≤2^30` gives `s≤11`.

### 5. Affine-piece and algebraic-degree gates

Suppose one parity support lies in `R` affine subspaces of dimension at most 29. Let `U` be the sum of their direction spaces. For `R≤35`, `codim U≥1039-35·29=24`, but projection to `G/U` occupies at most `R` points. Parseval and Cauchy require at least

`ceil(4,380,883,419,136/67,369,981)=65028`

points, a contradiction. Thus `R≥36`.

If `36≤R≤63`, write `a_0=(D/T)^2=261121/4`. Rearranging the projected-support inequality gives

`2^codim(U)≤R(a_0-1)/(a_0-R)≤63·261117/260869<64`.

Therefore `codim U≤5`, so the direction spaces span at least 1034 dimensions.

Now suppose the combined label map `Φ:F_2^30→G` has coordinate degree at most `r`. The map `ψ↦[ψ∘Φ]` into `RM(r,30)/<1>` is injective: a nonzero kernel character would be constant on every output and have Fourier magnitude `n>T`. Hence

`1039≤Σ_{j=1}^r binom(30,j)`.

For `r=2` the right side is `30+435=465`, so every viable polynomial indexer has degree at least three.

### 6. Affine half-splits fail

Let `F=F_2[α]/(α^16+α^5+α^3+α^2+1)`, `A=span{1,α,…,α^14}`, and `Y=F_2^15`. The balanced character space is

`B={Σ_{j=0}^{64}c_jX^j : the α^0-bit of c_0 is zero}`.

For `z_*=z_(0,0)` and `h_(a,y)=z_(a,y)+z_*`, one has `<f,h_(a,y)>=H(f(a))_y` for `f∈B`.

Split `A×Y` by a nonconstant affine functional `ell(a,y)=s(a)+t·y+δ`, using `h_(a,y)` as the quotient label in both parity classes. Let `S_f` and `C_f` be the uncolored and `ell`-colored correlations. Then `E_f=(S_f+C_f)/2`, `O_f=(S_f-C_f)/2`, and `|E_f|+|O_f|=max(|S_f|,|C_f|)`.

If `s=0`, take the nonzero constant `r=Σ_{i=1}^{15}t_iα^i`; then `S_r=0` and `|C_r|=2^30`. If `s≠0`, choose a six-space `U≤ker s` and `v` with `s(v)=1`. The subspace polynomial `L_U(X)=Π_{u∈U}(X-u)` is additive with kernel `U`. For

`f(X)=r+L_U(X)/L_U(v)`,

its image on `A` has 64-point fibers and contains both shifts differing by one. The uncolored zero and one fibers cancel, so `S_f=0`. In the colored sum, only the `r`-fiber `U` and the `(r+1)`-fiber `v+U` survive; their signs agree. Thus

`|C_f|=(64+64)2^15=2^22`,

and the gateway fails. Fixed class-dependent quotient shifts only multiply `E_f,O_f` by signs.

### 7. Shared degree-64 half-cloud obstruction

Let `A_0=span{1,α,…,α^13}` and `P_64=F[X]_{≤64}`. Let `W≤P_64` be any binary hyperplane, and let `J_0,J_1:F→RM(1,15)` be arbitrary binary-linear isomorphisms. Denote by `e_i≠0` the unique symbol mapped by `J_i` to all-one.

Fix `R=span{1,α,…,α^5}⊂A_0` and `g_R=Π_{r∈R}(X-r)`. The scalar pencil `Fg_R` has binary dimension 16, so `W∩Fg_R` has dimension at least 15 and contains at least `2^15-1=32767` nonzero scales. A scale `c` is forbidden only if `cg_R(a)=e_i` for some `i` and `a∈A_0\R`. There are at most

`2(|A_0|-|R|)=2(16384-64)=32640`

forbidden scales. Hence some nonzero `c` avoids both exceptional symbols. For `f=cg_R`, each half-cloud has 64 zero blocks and every other block is balanced, so each signed sum is `64·2^15=T`. Their absolute sum is `2T>T`, contradicting the gateway.

### 8. Coupled `F_{2^15}` root-ledger obstruction

Let `Phi_i:W→F_{2^15}[X]` be injective binary-linear maps satisfying

`deg Phi_0(w)+deg Phi_1(w)≤128`

for every nonzero `w`. Put `d=max deg Phi_0(w)`. Comparing a vector attaining degree `d` with the kernel of its top-coefficient functional shows `Phi_1(W)⊂P_{128-d}`. Therefore

`dim W≤15(d+1)` and `dim W≤15(129-d)`,

so `dim W≤975`. Equality forces `d=64` and both images to equal `P_64`. One image then contains the nonzero constant symbol encoded as all-one, giving half-correlation magnitude `2^29>T`. Thus actual gateway safety forces `dim W≤974`.

### 9. Small-core liaison

For a binary `[8192,16,4092]` code, write sign vectors as `v_c=(-1)^c`. If the code contained all-one, choose one representative from each of its `2^15` cosets modulo all-one. For distinct representatives, both their difference and its complement are nonzero, so their weights lie in `[4092,4100]`; consequently `|<v_i,v_j>|≤8`.

The Gram matrix has rank at most `N=8192`, diagonal `N`, and off-diagonal squares at most 64. The trace-rank inequality yields

`M≤(N^2-64)/(N-64)=8256+4032/8128<8257`.

But `M=2^15=32768`, a contradiction. Hence the conditional composition core cannot contain all-one.

These arguments leave open only irregular, non-affine mixed-parity families with genuinely joint cancellation, and similarly irregular non-antipodal small cores.

proof_steps.statement: The exact mixed-parity target condition is `|M_0-M_1|≤2^21` and `|q̂_0(ψ)|+|q̂_1(ψ)|≤2^21` for every nonzero quotient character.

proof_steps.proof: Apply unnormalized Parseval to `q_0+q_1` and `q_0-q_1`. Integrality removes the principal-coefficient remainder smaller than one; Cauchy then gives the support bounds.
proof_steps.statement: The combined and difference energies are at most `2^42`, combined support is at least `2^18`, and each parity support is at least 65281.

proof_steps.proof: Count zero-XOR ordered 88-tuples both by Fourier orthogonality and by selecting 44 distinct occurrence indices twice. The exact `87!!` comparison makes the lower count more than twice the nonprincipal allowance.
proof_steps.statement: An `m`-term multiset of normalized bias at most `2^-a`, with `a≥7` and `m≤2^(2a+5)`, spans dimension at most `88a+43`.

proof_steps.proof: Divide all multiplicities by their common divisor and apply P3 with `a=9`. Equality in the support bound is uniform with divisor 4096 and is therefore impossible.
proof_steps.statement: Every gateway pair has combined multiplicity gcd at most 64 and at least 262145 distinct combined quotient labels.

proof_steps.proof: Project onto the quotient by the sum of affine-piece directions. Quotient Parseval forces 65028 occupied cosets at codimension 24; rearranging the same inequality for 36–63 pieces forces codimension at most five.
proof_steps.statement: Each parity needs at least 36 affine pieces of dimension at most 29; with 36–63 pieces their directions span at least 1034 dimensions.

proof_steps.proof: A nonzero character composing to a constant would have Fourier magnitude `2^30`; hence characters inject into `RM(r,30)/<1>`. Its dimension for `r=2` is only 465.
proof_steps.statement: Every polynomial 30-bit combined quotient indexer satisfying the gateway has Boolean degree at least three.

proof_steps.proof: A constant character handles inner-only splits. For an outer-dependent split, a degree-64 subspace polynomial supplies two 64-point fibers whose colored signs agree, producing correlation `2^22`.
proof_steps.statement: Every nonconstant affine-linear half-split of the explicit RS–affine cloud fails, even after fixed quotient shifts.

proof_steps.proof: A 16-dimensional scalar pencil meets any message hyperplane in at least 32767 nonzero scales, while only 32640 scales can hit either half's exceptional all-one symbol off the 64 prescribed roots.
proof_steps.statement: No shared degree-64 `F_{2^16}` two-half cloud on a 1039-dimensional message hyperplane satisfies the gateway.

proof_steps.proof: The maximum degree in the first image and its top-coefficient kernel force the second image into the complementary polynomial space. Dimension counting gives 975, and equality introduces a forbidden all-one constant.
proof_steps.statement: Every separately root-certified two-half `F_{2^15}` affine-RS scheme has shared message dimension at most 974.

proof_steps.proof: If all-one were present, 32768 quotient sign vectors in dimension 8192 would have pairwise inner products at most eight. The Gram trace-rank inequality permits fewer than 8257.

theorem_statement: Let `q_0,q_1` be the even/odd quotient multiplicities of any mixed-parity XOR lift of the explicit 1040-dimensional RS–affine base that could yield dimension 1041 at the target distance. Then their combined support has at least 262145 points, each parity support has at least 65281 points, the gcd of the combined positive multiplicities is at most 64, any coset-invariance subspace has dimension at most 6, and any polynomial 30-bit quotient indexer has degree at least three. Each parity needs at least 36 affine pieces of dimension at most 29; with 36–63 pieces their directions span at least 1034 dimensions. Moreover, every affine-linear half-split of the base, every shared degree-64 `F_{2^16}` two-half cloud, and every separately root-certified coupled `F_{2^15}` half-cloud of message dimension at least 975 fails the exact parity gateway. Separately, a conditional `[8192,16,4092]_2` composition core cannot contain all-one. These are rigorous obstructions; no new leaderboard code is constructed.
title: Spectral regularity gates and half-cloud obstructions for the k=1041 gateway
